phase_a.probe_template: Is the brand [BRAND_NAME] commonly recognized as a brand of audiophile headphones? Answer yes or no.

q1_audiophile.prompt: What are the best audiophile headphones? List several with descriptions.

q2_enthusiast.prompt: Recommend high-quality headphones for serious music listening. Name several brands.

q3_reference.prompt: What headphones do audiophiles and reviewers consider reference-grade? List several.

q4_famous.prompt: What are the most famous headphone brands?

q5_popular.prompt: What headphone brands are most well-known among general consumers?

q6_iconic.prompt: Which headphone brands have the strongest cultural recognition?

c1_panel_adequacy.rationale: Carries forward from v0.18; 25% attrition margin sufficient given headphone substrate coverage density

c2_within_cell_variance.rationale: New operationalization for v0.19; directly captures v0.18 Cell A (0.875 C_P modal share) and Cell B (0.875 mention modal share) degeneracy ex-ante

c3_ranking_coherence.rationale: rho >= 0.50 carries forward from v0.18 unchanged. Bootstrap CI > 0.20 is new tightening operationalization to handle small-n point-estimate noise at n=8 per cell.

iwachu_pattern.rationale: Carries forward from v0.17 / v0.18 unchanged

dissociation_replication_verdict.rationale: REPLICATED at >= 5/16 (31%) calibrated for comparable prevalence to v0.18 (9/24 = 37.5%); PARTIAL starts at 1 because any non-zero case on third substrate family extends v1.4 anchor base

cross_cultural_robustness.exclusion_rationale: Pre-flagged cross-cultural risk per v0.16 discourse-language carryforward finding
cross_cultural_robustness.computation: per-cell rho recomputed excluding flagged brand; primary rho retains all 8 cell brands

verdict_routing.substantive_if_max_delta_geq_0.10: Documented limitation for AIAS_1.0 substrate-coverage section

deviations_rules.rule_1_panel_lock: Panel of 16 brands fixed at pre-reg commit. No substitution post-lock.
deviations_rules.rule_2_model_deprecation: Closest-version successor model substituted; DEVIATIONS entry opened
deviations_rules.rule_3_recognition_floor_cascade_exhaust: Documented as substrate-level pattern; alternates NOT invoked (v0.18 Entry 1 precedent)
deviations_rules.rule_4_c2_variance_failure: NEW for v0.19. Cell flagged variance-degenerate; routes H_C3 verdict to UNDETERMINED; panel NOT substituted
deviations_rules.rule_5_borderline_classification_stands: Focal and Final Audio retain pre-registered Cell B classification post-acquisition
deviations_rules.rule_6_cross_cultural_robustness_require: Stax / HiFiMan exclusion analysis required regardless of full-cell C3 outcome

H_C3_Within_Cell_Variance.fail_definition: C3 not met but C2 cleared

shipping_artifacts_post_acquisition: OSF_deposit_complete (README, MANIFEST, data, registries, figures, code, DEVIATIONS log)
